GCA Bay Area Ras Garba – October 17th

Get ready for a vibrant evening of Ras Garba, Gujarati music, traditional dance, and Navratri celebration in Fremont. Enjoy an energetic musical experience featuring the Aanal & Achal Anjaria Team from Sharda Musical Group, and celebrate the spirit of Gujarati culture with family and friends.

Event details

Date: Saturday, October 17, 2026

Time: 7:30 PM PDT

Doors Open: 7:00 PM

Venue: Washington High School

Address: 38442 Boulevard, Fremont, CA 94536

General admission and group tickets for 8 or more are available.

Join us for an unforgettable night of Garba, music, dance, and Navratri celebration.
